group.title: Changes to a train service
group.passage: M1: May I have your attention, please? Passengers for the ten-fifteen service to Northbridge should remain in the main waiting area. A signal fault has closed the eastern tracks, and our train is currently unable to enter the station. Engineers expect to restore the signals within twenty minutes, but we cannot yet confirm a departure platform. Please do not proceed to platform six, which is shown on printed tickets. The electronic boards will display the correct platform when one is assigned. If this delay causes you to miss a reserved connection, staff at the information desk can arrange onward travel without an additional booking fee. We will provide another update at ten-twenty.
group.passageZh: 請注意，搭乘十點十五分往Northbridge列車的旅客，請留在主要候車區。號誌故障造成東側軌道關閉，目前列車無法進站。工程師預計二十分鐘內修復，但目前仍無法確認出發月台。請勿前往紙本車票上的第六號月台。分配完成後，電子看板會顯示正確月台。若因此錯過已訂的轉乘，服務台人員可協助後續行程，不加收訂位費。我們十點二十分會再次公告。
